Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: CobaltPay security questionnaire — control footprint & evidence onboarding

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is CobaltPay's RFP and security questionnaire (high level + SIG appendix). We're running a compliance intake for our payments platform and need a two-part response: (1) a control-footprint mapping showing which SOC 2/ISO/SIG controls Redwood is in-scope for (including managed vs customer responsibilities), and (2) an artifact onboarding plan for evidence we will request (SOC 2 Type II report, audit logs, identity proofing, encryption config).

Key asks and timeline:
- Can you provide a preliminary control mapping within 5 business days?
- We need an evidence onboarding plan and collection window (we expect a 3-week window to exchange artifacts).
- Please confirm data residency options (we are EU-first; data-at-rest/backups) and whether you offer dedicated tenancy or VPC control plane options.
- Provide the latest SOC 2 Type II date and a short summary of scope (systems/users included).

I attached: CobaltPay_RFP_2028.pdf. Procurement is cc'd for contractual steps.

Next steps: an initial walkthrough next week would be great; can you propose 30 minutes?

Regards,
Elaine Martin
Head of Procurement, CobaltPay
elaine.martin@cobaltpay.com

Elaine,

Thanks — we received the RFP. Attaching an initial one-page SOC 2 summary and a blank control-mapping template to accelerate mapping on our side. High level answers below to expedite procurement:

- SOC 2 Type II: Yes — most recent report period ended 2028-03-31. Scope: Redwood hosted inference platform (control plane), dedicated model serving, and console operations. We'll include the executive summary and auditor letter in the artifact packet.
- Data residency: We support EU-region hosting with customer-managed VPC options for Private deployments; hosted API data retention defaults are 30 days for logs and 7 days for request bodies unless a retention SLA is negotiated.
- Dedicated tenancy: Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) available; Dedicated pool contracts available for committed capacity.

Proposed plan:
1) We will return a draft control mapping within 4 business days (by Tue 2028-06-25).
2) Artifact onboarding: we propose a 3-week window starting once you confirm which artifacts you need. We'll stage documents on a secure shared folder and redact as required.
3) Walkthrough: propose Mon 2028-06-24 09:00-09:30 or Tue 2028-06-25 14:00-14:30 (CEST). Please let us know a slot.

Attachments provided: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, control-mapping-template.xlsx. I'll loop Kar this thread for the MAP and commercial/contract notes.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
